pairs.target: huí xuégōng liǎngtiān hòu de xiàwǔ , tǎ wéi bèijiào qù rèn yìzhī xiāngzǐ .
pairs.english: On the afternoon two days after returning to the academy, Tavi was called to inspect a crate.
pairs.hanzi: 回学宫两天后的下午，塔维被叫去认一只箱子。

pairs.target: xiāngzǐ bǎizài liànxí shì dìshàng , gàizi dǎkāi , lǐmiàn de mùgé zhènghǎo kǎzhù liǎngfù xiǎo jiājù .
pairs.english: The crate stood on the practice-room floor, open, its wooden compartments fitting two small fixtures exactly.
pairs.hanzi: 箱子摆在练习室地上，盖子打开，里面的木格正好卡住两副小夹具。

pairs.target: shí yán dūn zài pángbiān , bǎ juàn hǎo de ruǎn bùsāijìn kòngxì . jiàn tǎ wéi lái , tā jǔqǐ shǒu , quē jiǎo de mǔzhǐ cháo shàng , xiàng yígè bú tài wánzhěng de zhāohū .
pairs.english: Shiyan crouched beside it, stuffing rolled soft cloth into the gaps. Seeing Tavi, he raised a hand, his chipped thumbnail pointing up like an incomplete greeting.
pairs.hanzi: 石延蹲在旁边，把卷好的软布塞进空隙。见塔维来，他举起手，缺角的拇指朝上，像一个不太完整的招呼。

pairs.target: wéi lǎoshī jiāng yìzhāng xíngchéng dān dìgěi tǎ wéi , shuō shí zhuó xiū péng yào zhuāng jǐfù kě chāi de lánshuǐ kuàng , xuégōng dāying pài rén xiézuò .
pairs.english: Instructor Vey handed Tavi an itinerary: the Stonewash repair depot needed removable water-screen frames assembled, and the academy had agreed to send help.
pairs.hanzi: 维老师将一张行程单递给塔维，说石濯修棚要装几副可拆的拦水框，学宫答应派人协作。

pairs.target: zhè yítàng sìtiān , sāntiān hòu chūfā , dìsìtiān huílái , zǒu yǐjīng tōngxíng de shānlù hé hébiān chēdào . " nǐ yuànbuyuànyì qù ? "
pairs.english: “Four days this trip. Leave in three days, return on the fourth day, along established mountain roads and the riverside cart road.” “Would you like to go?”
pairs.hanzi:
这一趟四天，三天后出发，第四天回来，走已经通行的山路和河边车道。
“你愿不愿意去？”

pairs.target: tǎ wéi xiān wèn shí zhuó zài nǎlǐ . wèn wán cái yǒudiǎn liǎn rè , yǐwéi zìjǐ gāi zhīdào . tā què ràng shí yán ná tú lái .
pairs.english: Tavi first asked where Stonewash was, then flushed a little, thinking he ought to know. She simply had Shiyan bring a map.
pairs.hanzi: 塔维先问石濯在哪里。问完才有点脸热，以为自己该知道。她却让石延拿图来。

pairs.target: shí zhuó zài xiàfāng yìtiáo zhī hé páng , lí tóng jiē búsuàn hěn yuǎn , chēlù què ràokāi dǒupō , bùnéng ná zhǐ shàng de zhíxiàn suàn bàntiān .
pairs.english: Stonewash lay below, beside a tributary, not very far from Copperstep, but the cart road skirted steep slopes; a straight line on paper did not make it half a day’s journey.
pairs.hanzi: 石濯在下方一条支河旁，离铜阶不算很远，车路却绕开陡坡，不能拿纸上的直线算半天。

pairs.target: tā kànjiàn nàtiáo hé zài tú biān yòu chàkāi , hūrán xiǎngqǐ dí qīng shuō jiā zài " nàbiān ". zhèhuí tā méiyǒu bǎ kànbùdǒng de dìfāng cáng qǐlái , zhuī zhe wèn wǎnshàng zhù nǎlǐ , huíchéng shì nǎyìtiáo lù .
pairs.english: Seeing the river branch again at the map’s edge, he remembered Diqing saying her home was “over there.” This time he did not hide his uncertainty, asking where they would sleep and which road led back to the city.
pairs.hanzi: 他看见那条河在图边又岔开，忽然想起荻青说家在“那边”。这回他没有把看不懂的地方藏起来，追着问晚上住哪里，回城是哪一条路。

pairs.target: shí yán tì tā zhǐ dào xiū péng hòumiàn de zhùwū , yòu shuō huǒshí búcuò , yán fàng dé xiàng búyào qián . tǎ wéi bùzhī gāi xìn nǎ yíbàn , shí yán yǐjīng xiào le , shuō dìyījù shì zhēnde , dìèrjù dé kàn shuí dāngbān .
pairs.english: Shiyan pointed out the lodging behind the depot and said the food was good, the salt used as though it were free. Tavi did not know which half to believe; Shiyan laughed and said the first was true, the second depended on who was cooking.
pairs.hanzi: 石延替他指到修棚后面的住屋，又说伙食不错，盐放得像不要钱。塔维不知该信哪一半，石延已经笑了，说第一句是真的，第二句得看谁当班。

pairs.target: fùzé zhè tàng zhuāngpèi de shì ruì shīfu . wéi lǎoshī shuō tā huì dài yǐjīng hézhǔn de xiǎo tiě duì hé jiājù , tǎ wéi zhī zuò biǎo shàng zhǔnxǔ de zhǔnbèi , cè dú hé xiézuò , xiànchǎng yóu tā kānshǒu .
pairs.english: Master Rui was responsible for the assembly. Instructor Vey said she would bring approved small iron pairs and fixtures; Tavi would do only the preparation, readings and assistance permitted by his sheet, supervised by her on site.
pairs.hanzi: 负责这趟装配的是芮师傅。维老师说她会带已经核准的小铁对和夹具，塔维只做表上准许的准备、测读和协作，现场由她看守。

pairs.target: hé shàng de jiù zhá lìng yǒurén chá , nài lěi yě qù , nà bù guī xuéshēng dòng .
pairs.english: Others would inspect the old river sluice, Nerai among them; students would not work on it.
pairs.hanzi: 河上的旧闸另有人查，奈蕾也去，那不归学生动。

pairs.target: tā dītóu kàn xiāngzǐ . nàxiē zài zhuōshàng shúxī de mù zuò zhuāngjìnqù yǐhòu , jìng xiǎnchū yìzhǒng yào chūyuǎnmén de yàngzi .
pairs.english: He looked down at the crate. Packed inside, the wooden bases familiar from the table looked suddenly ready for a distant journey.
pairs.hanzi: 他低头看箱子。那些在桌上熟悉的木座装进去以后，竟显出一种要出远门的样子。

pairs.target: liǎngkuài bù gékāi tiěpiàn , biānshàng liú zhe fàng jìlù hé xiǎo bǎi de cáo , suǒyǒu dōngxī dōu dé zài lìng yìzhāng méi jiàn guò de zhuōshàng chóngxīn bǎi wěn .
pairs.english: Two cloths separated the iron strips, with slots beside them for records and the little pendulum; everything would have to be set firmly anew on an unfamiliar table.
pairs.hanzi: 两块布隔开铁片，边上留着放记录和小摆的槽，所有东西都得在另一张没见过的桌上重新摆稳。

pairs.target: tā dāying le . wéi lǎoshī jiào tā bǎ xíngchéng chāo yífèn , liúgěi jiālǐ hé sùshè , zài wèn zhè jǐtiān yǒuméiyǒu biéde yuēdìng .
pairs.english: He agreed. Instructor Vey told him to copy the itinerary for home and the dormitory, then asked about other commitments during those days.
pairs.hanzi: 他答应了。维老师叫他把行程抄一份，留给家里和宿舍，再问这几天有没有别的约定。

pairs.target: tǎ wéi xiǎng le xiǎng , shuō méiyǒu , suíhòu xiǎngqǐ zìjǐ dāying mǐlā yǒukōng bāng tā bāndōngxī , liánmáng bǔ shàng . lǎoshī ràng tā qù jiǎngqīng , búyào chūfā nàtiān cái ràng biérén fāxiàn shǎo le yì shuāngshǒu .
pairs.english: Tavi thought and said no, then remembered his offer to help Mira carry things if free and hastily added it. The teacher told him to explain now, rather than leave others short a pair of hands on departure day.
pairs.hanzi: 塔维想了想，说没有，随后想起自己答应米拉有空帮她搬东西，连忙补上。老师让他去讲清，不要出发那天才让别人发现少了一双手。

pairs.target: mǐlā hé sū yǐ zài gōngfáng cèmén . tāmen búshì lái děng huíxìn , shǒulǐ gè ná zhe yìgēn bùtóng de mùtiáo , zhèngzài zhēng nǎ yìgēn xīshuǐ yǐhòu gèng róngyì qiào .
pairs.english: Mira and Suyi were at the works’ side door, not waiting for a reply. Each held a different wooden strip, arguing which would warp more readily after absorbing water.
pairs.hanzi: 米拉和苏苡在工房侧门。她们不是来等回信，手里各拿着一根不同的木条，正在争哪一根吸水以后更容易翘。

pairs.target: tǎ wéi jiāng xíngchéng gěi mǐlā kàn , shuō zìjǐ bùnéng bāng tā bān le . tā kàn wán , dìyījù jìngshì wèn tā yǒuméiyǒu dài gān wà .
pairs.english: Tavi showed Mira the itinerary and said he could not help her carry things. Her first question, surprisingly, was whether he had packed dry socks.
pairs.hanzi: 塔维将行程给米拉看，说自己不能帮她搬了。她看完，第一句竟是问他有没有带干袜。

pairs.target: tā shuō hái mò shōushí , tā yòng mùtiáo zài tā xuē biān qīngqīng diǎn le yíxià , shuō dé mǎ bú zài , zhèxiē huà zhōngyú lún dào biérén jiǎng .
pairs.english: He said he had not packed yet. She tapped lightly beside his boot with the strip, saying with Dema away, somebody else finally got to say these things.
pairs.hanzi: 他说还没收拾，她用木条在他靴边轻轻点了一下，说德玛不在，这些话终于轮到别人讲。

pairs.target: sū yǐ bǎ liǎnggēn mùtiáo bìng qǐlái , tì tā jiěshì nàtiān kàn cáiliào de jiéguǒ . gōngfáng kěn jiè yìzhāng shì tái , ràng tāmen àn liǎngzhī xiǎohé de chǐcùn zuò shíyàng , liào qián xiānzhào zuì pǔtōng de mùliào suàn , hái méi dāying nádào zhùhù shuǐgōu lǐ qù .
pairs.english: Suyi laid the strips together and explained the materials visit. The works would lend a bench for full-sized prototypes of both small boxes, charging ordinary timber prices for now, without agreeing to install them in residents’ ditches.
pairs.hanzi: 苏苡把两根木条并起来，替她解释那天看材料的结果。工房肯借一张试台，让她们按两只小盒的尺寸做实样，料钱先照最普通的木料算，还没答应拿到住户水沟里去。

pairs.target: lǎoshī yào kàn chāi qǔ , chéngzhòng , yě yào kàn shuǐ dà shí yèzi zěnme guò . mǐlā shuō tā xiànzài zuì xiǎng zuò de , shì ràng liǎnggè hézi gèzì néng tíchū lái , shǒu búbì kuàguò zhōngjiān .
pairs.english: The teacher wanted to inspect removal, load-bearing and leaf passage in high flow. Mira said her main aim now was to lift each box independently, without reaching across the centre.
pairs.hanzi:
老师要看拆取、承重，也要看水大时叶子怎么过。
米拉说她现在最想做的，是让两个盒子各自能提出来，手不必跨过中间。

pairs.target: dǎobǎn hái dé zài gǎi , bùnéng yīnwèi xiǎo shuǐ shùn , jiù bǎ dàshuǐ nà yìlán cáng diào .
pairs.english: The guide still needed changing; good low flow was no excuse to hide the high-flow column.
pairs.hanzi: 导板还得再改，不能因为小水顺，就把大水那一栏藏掉。

pairs.target: tā shuō dé hěnkuài , yì shǒunázhe mùtiáo , yìshǒu bǐ hé kǒu , tǎ wéi jìng méi chā dé shàng huà . zhídào sū yǐ wèn tā dàodǐ xuǎn nǎ gēn , tā cái tíngxià , fāxiànzìjǐ bǎ liǎnggēn dōu shuō chéng le bùxíng . " nà jiù xiān gè pào yì jié . " tā shuō .
pairs.english: She spoke fast, holding timber in one hand and gesturing at the box mouth with the other; Tavi could not get a word in. Only when Suyi asked which strip she actually chose did she stop, realizing she had ruled out both. “Then soak a piece of each first,” she said.
pairs.hanzi:
她说得很快，一手拿着木条，一手比盒口，塔维竟没插得上话。直到苏苡问她到底选哪根，她才停下，发现自己把两根都说成了不行。
“那就先各泡一截。”她说。

pairs.target: tǎ wéi xiào le , wèn yào buyào xiànzài tì tāmen tíshuǐ . mǐlā kàn tā yìyǎn , shuō qù ba , hái méi chūmén de rén , shǒu dǎo xiān shōu qǐlái le .
pairs.english: Tavi laughed and asked if he should fetch water now. Mira glanced at him and said go on; he had not left yet, but his hands were already off duty.
pairs.hanzi: 塔维笑了，问要不要现在替她们提水。米拉看他一眼，说去吧，还没出门的人，手倒先收起来了。

pairs.target: wǎnshàng yīwén tì tā héduì xíngchéng chāoběn , jiāng shōuxìn chù de zì xiě dà . tǎ wéi wèn tā yào buyào yìqǐ qù , huà chūkǒu cái xiǎngqǐ zhè búshì yítàng kàn hé de yóuwán .
pairs.english: That evening Iven checked his itinerary copy and enlarged the receiving address. Tavi asked whether he wanted to come too, only remembering afterward this was not a pleasure trip to see the river.
pairs.hanzi: 晚上伊文替他核对行程抄本，将收信处的字写大。塔维问他要不要一起去，话出口才想起这不是一趟看河的游玩。

pairs.target: yīwén què méi xiào tā , shuō zìjǐ zài guò shítiān yào péi fùqīn qù yícì yùn shuǐlù de huì , dé xiān bǎ liǎngzhāng jiù tú de biāozhù chāo qīng . nàbiān zhēng de shì shuí děng shuǐ , shuí děng chuán , tā xiànzài lián rénjiā de shōuhuò rì dōu jì bù quán , qù le yě bùnéng zhī huì zhǐ hé .
pairs.english: Iven did not laugh. He said he would accompany his father to a water-transport meeting in ten days and first had to copy the annotations on two old maps. They were arguing over who waited for water and who for boats; he could not even remember everyone’s delivery days, and could not go merely knowing where the river was.
pairs.hanzi: 伊文却没笑他，说自己再过十天要陪父亲去一次运水路的会，得先把两张旧图的标注抄清。那边争的是谁等水、谁等船，他现在连人家的收货日都记不全，去了也不能只会指河。

pairs.target: tǎ wéi bǎ zìjǐ de xiǎo běnzi ná chūlái , fān dào kòngbáiyè . shàngcì tā jì dēngguāng , zhècì xiǎng jì rén zěnme zài hébiān gànhuó .
pairs.english: Tavi took out his little notebook and opened a blank page. Last time he recorded lights; this time he wanted to record how people worked beside the river.
pairs.hanzi: 塔维把自己的小本子拿出来，翻到空白页。上次他记灯光，这次想记人怎么在河边干活。

pairs.target: yīwén shuō yě jì diǎn wǎnfàn , yàoshi tiāntiān yǒu hǎochī de , huílái shǎobùliǎo yídùn . tǎ wéi dáyīng dé hěnkuài . děng yīwén wèn tā ná shénme qǐng , tā cái dītóu fān qiándài , tīngjiàn duìmiàn yǐjīng rěnbúzhù zài xiào .
pairs.english: Iven said to note the dinners too; if the food was good every day, he would owe them a meal back home. Tavi agreed quickly. Only when Iven asked how he would pay did he look into his purse, hearing his friend already failing to suppress a laugh.
pairs.hanzi:
伊文说也记点晚饭，要是天天有好吃的，回来少不了一顿。
塔维答应得很快。等伊文问他拿什么请，他才低头翻钱袋，听见对面已经忍不住在笑。
